resources.string: ZenMode uses this Accessibility Service for two things: to lock your screen when you tap the lock button on the home screen, and (only when you turn on in-app content blocking) to detect when a screen you chose to block (such as YouTube Shorts) is open, so it can navigate you away. It checks only which screen is showing; it does not read, store, or share the content itself, and does nothing for apps you have not chosen to block.
